name: Taifoon × NEAR AI Cloud — the provider entry (one external provider, in NEAR's admin shape)

nodes.name: Provider entry
nodes.notes: The whole entry. On NEAR AI Cloud it becomes one row per model in PATCH /v1/admin/models (providerType external, providerConfig {backend, base_url, model_name, api_key}). The key behind TAIFOON_API_KEY is minted at POST https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/register and funded by a USDC top-up on Base (GET /v1/access/quote); set it as an n8n environment variable. Its value is never in this workflow.

nodes.name: Read the Taifoon catalogue
nodes.notes: Discovery at {base_url}/{models_path}: OpenAI-shaped data[], each model with taifoon.usd_per_1m {in, out} and taifoon.model_identity {weights, venue}.

nodes.name: Read NEAR AI's model list
nodes.notes: Public, no key: every model NEAR lists with its modelId, aliases and price per token. A row is written only for weights not listed here.

nodes.name: Shape the admin batch
nodes.notes: Pure. Only weights NEAR does not list are written; overlaps and alias collisions are reported for NEAR to decide.

nodes.name: PATCH /v1/admin/models — NEAR runs this
nodes.notes: Disabled on purpose: NEAR's admin call (admin session or read_write token). The body is the map from the node before; api_key is added at send time from the environment variable the entry names.
